seats.role: Constitutional body that elects and can remove the Supreme Leader; under Article 111 it must elect a new supreme leader after removal or death.

seats.name: Interim Leadership Council
seats.role: Temporary body (President, Judiciary Chief, Guardian Council fuqaha member) assuming leader duties pending election of a new supreme leader under Article 111.

seats.name: Donald Trump
seats.role: U.S. President who authorized Operation Epic Fury and called for regime change/opposition takeover; his decisions affect whether the leadership is decapitated or pressured out.

seats.role: Israeli Prime Minister who lobbied for and adopted plans to strike Iran's leadership and encourage uprising.

seats.name: Reza Pahlavi
seats.role: Prominent opposition figure urging supporters to await his 'final call' before overthrowing the government.
